desc: Check if the given volume exists
r: podman-volume-exists - Check if the given volume exists
podman volume exists checks if a volume exists. Podman returns an exit code of 0 when the volume is found. A 1 is returned otherwise. An exit code of 125 indicates there was another issue.

Check if a volume called myvol exists (the volume does actually exist).

$ podman volume exists myvol
$ echo $?
0
$

Check if a volume called mysql exists (the volume does not actually exist).

$ podman volume exists mysql
$ echo $?
1
$
